name: Hydrating Facial Cleanser

name: Moisturizing Cream
description: A rich, fragrance-free moisturizer with ceramides and hyaluronic acid for dry skin on the face and body.

description: A daily facial moisturizer with broad-spectrum SPF 30 and ceramides. Apply generously before sun exposure and reapply as directed on the label.

name: Revitalift 1.5% Pure Hyaluronic Acid Serum
description: A lightweight facial serum formulated with hyaluronic acid to help skin feel hydrated and appear smoother.

name: True Match Super-Blendable Foundation
description: A blendable liquid foundation available in a range of shades and finishes. Match the shade to your skin tone and follow the package directions.

name: Elvive Hyaluron Plump Hydrating Shampoo
description: A hydrating shampoo from the Hyaluron Plump haircare range. Massage into wet hair and rinse thoroughly.

name: SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water
description: A micellar water cleanser for removing makeup and cleansing skin. Use with a cotton pad and follow the product label.

name: SkinActive Vitamin C Serum
description: A brightening facial serum featuring vitamin C. Introduce gradually, follow the package directions, and wear sunscreen during the day.

name: Fructis Hair Filler + Hyaluronic Moisture Shampoo
description: A moisturizing shampoo from the Fructis Hair Filler range. Work through wet hair and rinse well.

name: Advanced Génifique Serum
description: A lightweight face serum intended for use as part of a daily skincare routine. Check the current packaging for ingredients and directions.

name: Idôle Eau de Parfum
description: A modern floral eau de parfum. Apply as directed, avoiding eyes and irritated skin.

name: Ultra Facial Cream
description: A daily facial moisturizer formulated to help skin feel soft and hydrated. Use after cleansing and serum.

name: Lash Sensational Washable Mascara
description: A washable mascara for defining lashes. Use only around the eye area as directed and replace according to package guidance.

name: Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Cleanser
description: A gentle facial cleanser formulated for normal to dry skin. Use according to the product label and rinse as directed.

name: Bare With Me Concealer Serum
description: A serum-style concealer for targeted complexion coverage. Apply a small amount and blend as desired.
